name: Ambu A/S
summary: Ambu A/S, together with its subsidiaries, researches, develops, manufactures, markets, and sells medical technology solutions in North America, Europe, and internationally. The company offers endoscopy products, including bronchoscopes, video laryngoscopes, rhinolaryngoscopes, duodenoscopes, gastroscopes, cystoscopes, ureteroscopes, and displaying and processing units; neurology products, such as EEG and EMG electrodes, EMG guided injections, and intraoperative monitoring products; and cardiology products comprising ECG electrodes.
